Class VisualizationController<I, C extends AlgorithmContext<I>>

java.lang.Object
io.github.mcalgovisualizations.visualization.engine.VisualizationController<I,C>
All Implemented Interfaces:
PlayerControls
public class VisualizationController<I, C extends AlgorithmContext<I>> extends Object implements PlayerControls
Coordinates trace playback, stepping, speed changes, and user feedback for a visualization session.

This controller owns the session state machine and bridges the trace builder, renderer, and player feedback layer.
